ingredients: ⅔ cup (65 g) seedless raisins (a handful more if you like them)
⅔ cup (120 g) packed dark brown sugar
steps: Line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, stir together flour, raisins, brown sugar, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking powder, and salt until well combined; break up brown sugar clumps, which resemble flour-coated raisins.
Stir in molasses, butter, vanilla, and egg until fully integrated. Shape dough into two strips approximately 6 x 3 inches, separated by at least 1.5 inches on the sheet pan.
Bake 12–15 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out dry.
Cool slightly, then transfer the hermits on their parchment to cooling racks. Cool completely, checking that their bottoms are no longer warmer than room temperature.
Transfer the hermits on their parchment to a counter. Cut into 1.5-inch-wide strips with a pizza cutter and carefully scrape away from parchment using a thin spatula.
Enjoy with a glass of milk or a nice cup of tea.
